caption.text:
Kapolri Jenderal Listyo Sigit Prabowo bersilaturahmi dengan Jaksa Agung ST Burhanuddin di Kantor Kejagung, Jakarta Selatan. Burhanuddin menyebut Sigit sebagai sahabat.

Burhanuddin mengatakan kedatangan Sigit dan jajaran Polri bukan hal baru. Dia mengatakan tak ada persaingan antara dua institusi penegak hukum tersebut.

“Ini adalah bukan program baru, ini program lama. Kemudian, kami juga, saya dengan Kapolri, teman-teman jangan berpikir kami ini rival, kami ini adalah versus. Tidak. Sejak dulu sudah mengenal secara pribadi beliau. Kami sama-sama, saya jadi Jaksa Agung, beliau jadi Kapolri,” ujarnya usai pertemuan dengan Kapolri di Gedung Kejagung, Jakarta Selatan, Senin (13/7/2026).

Baca berita selengkapnya hanya di detik.com! 

Video: Ori Salfian 
Creator: Putri

caption.text_translation:
Chief of Police General Listyo Sigit Prabowo interacted with the Attorney General ST Burhanuddin at the Kejagung Office, South Jakarta. Burhanuddin mentioned Sigit as a friend.

Burhanuddin said the arrival of Sigit and the rank of Polri is not new. He said there was no competition between the two law enforcement institutions.

“This is not a new program, this is an old program. Then we too, me with kapolri, guys don't think we're rivals, we're versus. Nope. I have known him personally for a long time. We are together, I become the Attorney General, he becomes the Kapolri," he said after the meeting with Kapolri in Gedung Kejagung, South Jakarta, Monday (13/7/2026).

 Creator: Putri
